hook: No squaring. No calculator. Just one rule.

instagram.caption:
No squaring. No calculator. Just one rule.

55² − 30² looks hard. It's one multiplication.

The identity a² − b² = (a+b)(a−b) turns two squares into a sum and a difference.

Add: 85. Subtract: 25. Multiply: 85 × 25 = 2125.

Save this and try it on your own two squares.
